``activity`` is the emitted activity's JSON object as the BT captured
it, or ``None`` when the tree completed without capturing one (an
idempotent no-op path); the key is emitted either way.
``emitting_actor_id`` names the actor whose outbox holds the activity — on
a delegated emit that is the CASE_MANAGER, not the requesting actor
(CM-24-001), and the router drains that actor's outbox.
ActivityResult.title: ActivityResult

Accepts any existing AS2 object identified by ``object_id``.  The object
must already exist in the actor's datalayer.  Type-specific convenience
endpoints (e.g., ``add-report-to-case``) delegate to this after
performing their own type validation (TRIG-10-001, TRIG-10-002).

TRIG-03-002: Unknown fields are silently ignored (extra="ignore").
AddObjectToCaseRequest.title: AddObjectToCaseRequest

AddOnBehalfStatusRequest.description:
Request body for the add-on-behalf-status trigger.

A Case Manager or Case Owner records a vendor's awareness (``v→V``,
``vf_state="Vf"``) or a deployer's deployment (``d→D``, ``d_state="D"``)
on behalf of an existing participant (ADR-0121; PRM-06-003, PRM-06-004).
A v→V target is typically an invitee that has not yet replied; a d→D
target must be a deployer at RM ``ACCEPTED``, ``DEFERRED`` or
``CLOSED``.  ``target_actor_id`` names that participant; a
non-participant target is refused and no participant is created
(PRM-06-006).  Only the upward rungs are assertable on another actor's
behalf: ``vf_state`` must be ``"Vf"`` and ``d_state`` must be ``"D"``.
``vf_state="VF"`` (``f→F``) is refused because fix readiness is not
externally knowable and is only ever self-declared by the Vendor-role
holder (PRM-06-005); the lower rungs (``"vf"``, ``"d"``) are refused
because recording unawareness or non-deployment on someone's behalf is
not an assertion PRM-06 permits.  At least one of ``vf_state`` /
``d_state`` is required.

TRIG-03-002: Unknown fields are silently ignored.
AddOnBehalfStatusRequest.title: AddOnBehalfStatusRequest

AddReportToCaseRequest.description:
Request body for the add-report-to-case trigger endpoint.

TRIG-03-001: Must include case_id and report_id.
TRIG-03-002: Unknown fields are silently ignored (extra="ignore").
AddReportToCaseRequest.title: AddReportToCaseRequest

CS_d.description:
Deployer-path sub-machine: fix deployment (2 states).

Monotone ladder: d → D.
CS_d.title: CS_d

CS_vf.description:
Vendor-path sub-machine: vendor awareness + fix readiness (3 states).

Monotone ladder: vf → Vf → VF.
CS_vf.title: CS_vf

CVDRole.description:
Individual CVD role values (lowercase string enum).

Each member represents a single, atomic CVD role. Participants may hold
multiple roles simultaneously; use ``list[CVDRole]`` at call sites rather
than bitmask arithmetic.

Values are lowercase strings (e.g. ``CVDRole.REPORTER == 'reporter'``).

There is no ``FINDER`` role (ADR-0078): an actor that discovers and
reports a vulnerability holds ``REPORTER``, and who found it is report or
note metadata.  The retired wire value ``"finder"`` is refused, see
``RETIRED_ROLE_VALUES``.

Roles:
    REPORTER: Entity that reports the vulnerability to others.
    VENDOR: Supplier of the affected product or service.
    DEPLOYER: Entity that deploys the fix.
    COORDINATOR: Entity that coordinates the CVD process.
    OBSERVER: Monitoring participant with no vendor-fix-deployment
        obligations; the base (lowest non-null privilege) CVD role.
        Admitted via standard Invite/Accept (CM-25). Formerly ``OTHER``;
        renamed in ADR-0057.
    CASE_OWNER: Actor who owns and manages a VulnerabilityCase (BTND-05-001).
    CASE_MANAGER: The ActivityStreams Actor that performs ongoing case
        replica synchronisation and manages the case on behalf of the case
        owner.  A CaseManager participant SHOULD also hold the COORDINATOR
        role (CBT-01-003); nothing requires it.  While the demo uses a
        Service actor type, any Actor type (e.g. Person) may hold this
        role.
    CVE_NUMBERING_AUTHORITY: Participant that holds CVE Numbering Authority
        (CNA) status, granting authority to assign CVE IDs.  A CNA is
        orthogonal to other CVD roles — a VENDOR, COORDINATOR, or any other
        participant may independently hold this role.  Used by
        ``IsIDAssignmentAuthority`` (static capability check) and
        ``IdAssignable`` (scope-match evaluation) BT nodes to route ID
        assignment decisions to the correct participant(s).
CVDRole.title: CVDRole

Request body for the demo sync-log-entry trigger.

Commits a canonical case ledger entry and fans it out to all participants
via Announce(CaseLedgerEntry). Uses Announce(VulnerabilityCase) as the
canonical payload type (case-actor-authored).

TRIG-03-002: Unknown fields are silently ignored.
SyncLogEntryRequest.title: SyncLogEntryRequest

SyncLogEntryResult.description:
``sync-log-entry``: the committed ledger entry's id, hash and index.

The demo-only verb that mints a canonical ``CaseLedgerEntry`` and fans it
out.  ``emitting_actor_id`` names the case's CASE_MANAGER, as whom the
commit tree ran and whose outbox holds the ``Announce(CaseLedgerEntry)``
fan-out (CLP-09, BT-05-005); the router drains that outbox, exactly as it
does for a delegated :class:`ActivityResult`.
SyncLogEntryResult.title: SyncLogEntryResult

TerminateEmbargoRequest.description:
Request body for the terminate-embargo trigger endpoint.

TRIG-03-001: Must include case_id to identify the target case.
TRIG-03-002: Unknown fields are silently ignored (extra="ignore").

``reason`` is what ends the embargo (ADR-0122).  ``EARLY``, the default,
is the actor's own decision to end it before its end time.
``END_TIME_REACHED`` is a request to end it at its end time, such as a
Sentinel monitoring embargo timers sends: refused before the end time,
and answered as already done, with no activity, once the embargo has
ended.
TerminateEmbargoRequest.title: TerminateEmbargoRequest

TerminationReason.description:
What ended an ``ACTIVE`` entry: its end time, or an early end (ADR-0122).

The *what* of a termination, and the only part that travels on the wire:
a termination ``Remove`` carries it as ``content``, checked at the parse
edge.  The *why* — a threat signal, for one — is a structured cause the
register entry records beside it
(:mod:`vultron.core.models.embargo_termination`).
TerminationReason.title: TerminationReason

post.description: Demo-only convenience wrapper. Creates a Note object, adds it to the actor's local copy of the case, and queues one Add(Note), which names the case as its target and carries the note inline, in the actor's outbox for delivery to the case's CASE_MANAGER. In a production deployment the actor's own BT would handle this step autonomously. Use the general ``add-object-to-case`` trigger at ``/trigger/`` when the Note already exists. Only available in ``RunMode.PROTOTYPE``. Spec: TRIG-09-001, TRIG-10-003.
post.summary: [Demo] Create a Note and add it to a case.

get.description: Demo-only read endpoint. Returns all ``CaseLedgerEntry`` objects for the specified case, sorted ascending by ``log_index``. Default response is ``application/json``. Request ``Accept: application/x-ndjson`` or pass ``?format=ndjson`` to receive NDJSON — one JSON object per line — suitable for direct file capture (``curl ... > case.jsonl``). This endpoint is for demo tooling, test scripts, and live display only. It MUST NOT be used as a participant-facing log-replication mechanism (use the ActivityStreams inbox channel per SYNC-02-001). Only available in ``RunMode.PROTOTYPE``. Spec: TRIG-09-001, SYNC-01-002, SYNC-02-003.
get.summary: [Demo] List all case ledger entries for a case, sorted by log_index.

get.description: Demo-only read endpoint. Returns a ``text/event-stream`` of the actor's ``CaseLedgerEntry`` objects for the specified case. Each event's ``id:`` is the entry's ``log_index`` and its ``data:`` is the entry serialized exactly as the ``…/log`` list endpoint serializes it. Stored entries are replayed first, in ``log_index`` order; ``?since=<log_index>`` or the ``Last-Event-ID`` header (sent by a browser ``EventSource`` on reconnect) skips entries at or below that index — when both are given, the higher one wins. The server then re-reads the actor's DataLayer on a short interval (``server.ledger_stream_poll_seconds``, default 0.25 s) and pushes each new entry, whether committed locally or replicated in. The stream ends when the client disconnects, and ends with a terminal ``event: close`` when the server shuts down. Tail it with ``curl -N``. This endpoint is for demo tooling, test scripts, and live display only. It MUST NOT be used as a participant-facing log-replication mechanism (use the ActivityStreams inbox channel per SYNC-02-001). Only available in ``RunMode.PROTOTYPE``. Spec: TRIG-09-001, SYNC-01-002, SYNC-02-003; ADR-0104.

post.summary: [Demo] Report that the vulnerability has been publicly disclosed.

post.description: Demo-only scaffold. Seeds ``stub_summary`` on the actor's local DataLayer copy of the case so that a subsequent ``invite-actor-to-case`` trigger can build the stub Invite (CM-17-010, MV-10-001, #4165). Only available in ``RunMode.PROTOTYPE``.
post.summary: [Demo] Seed stub_summary on the actor's DataLayer copy of a case.

post.description: Demo-only trigger. Commits a ``CaseLedgerEntry`` for the given case via the canonical BT commit path and queues an ``Announce(CaseLedgerEntry)`` per participant for fan-out delivery. Uses ``Announce(VulnerabilityCase)`` as the canonical payload type. Only available in ``RunMode.PROTOTYPE``. Spec: TRIG-09-001, SYNC-02-002, SYNC-02-003.
post.summary: [Demo] Commit a case ledger entry and fan it out to participants.

post.description: Emits an Accept(Offer(CaseParticipant)) from the Case Owner's identity addressed to the CaseActor, completing the ADR-0026 CM-16-006 approval step.  The Offer(CaseParticipant) must already exist in the actor's DataLayer (delivered by the CaseActor).
post.summary: Accept an actor recommendation as Case Owner.

post.description: Accepts an RmInviteToCaseActivity by emitting an RmAcceptInviteToCaseActivity queued in the actor's outbox for delivery to the case owner.
post.summary: Accept a case invitation.

post.description: Emits an Accept(Offer(VulnerabilityCase)) from the accepting actor to the case's CASE_MANAGER.  The ownership transfer offer must already exist in the actor's DataLayer (TRIG-11-002, CM-21-006).
post.summary: Accept a case ownership transfer offer.

post.description: Triggers the accept-embargo behavior for the given actor. A participant accepts the current (or specified) embargo proposal with Accept(Invite(EmbargoEvent)), which records its own consent and moves no EM state. The case owner's accept is its decision for the case, Accept(EmbargoEvent, target=Case), which activates the embargo (EM state → ACTIVE). Returns the resulting activity in the response body (TRIG-04-001).
post.summary: Trigger embargo acceptance (accept a proposal).

post.description: Answers the CASE_MANAGER's full-case Invite with Accept, carrying this actor's own ledger position.  Fails with 409 until the actor's ledger copy has reached the Invite's position (SYNC-10-004, CM-11-012).
post.summary: Judge the case valid: Accept(full-case Invite), RV.

post.description: Triggers the ack-report behavior for the given actor. Emits a Read(Offer(VulnerabilityReport)) activity (RK) to the reporter and returns it in the response body (TRIG-04-001). Only an actor the Offer was addressed to may acknowledge it; it may do so whether or not a case exists, and RK is never sent to the CASE_MANAGER (RMB-08-003).
post.summary: Trigger report acknowledgement.

post.description: Adds any existing AS2 object (identified by ``object_id``) to a VulnerabilityCase and queues an Add(object, target=case) activity in the actor's outbox addressed to the case's CASE_MANAGER alone, which commits it and replicates it to the participants (PCR-08-005). The object must already exist in the actor's datalayer. Returns 422 and queues nothing when no receiver would route the object as an addition to the case, when its type has its own flow (EmbargoEvent, CaseParticipant, CaseStatus), or when the case has no CASE_MANAGER. Type-specific convenience triggers (e.g., ``add-report-to-case``) delegate here after performing type validation (TRIG-10-001).
post.summary: Add an existing AS2 object to a case.

post.description: A Case Manager or Case Owner records, on behalf of an existing participant, the vendor's awareness (``vf_state="Vf"``, v→V; PRM-06-003; typically for an invitee that has not yet replied) or the deployer's deployment (``d_state="D"``, d→D; PRM-06-004; only for a deployer at RM Accepted, Deferred or Closed). The target must already be a participant holding the asserted role: a non-participant target is refused and no participant is created (PRM-06-006, ADR-0121). Writes a ParticipantStatus for the target and queues an Add(ParticipantStatus, target=CaseParticipant) activity to the Case Manager. Fix readiness (``vf_state="VF"``, f→F) is refused: it is only ever self-declared by the Vendor (PRM-06-005). Returns the ids of the queued activity and the stored status.
post.summary: Record a vendor's awareness or a deployer's deployment on their behalf.

post.description: Links a VulnerabilityReport to an existing VulnerabilityCase and queues an AddReportToCaseActivity in the actor's outbox addressed to the case's CASE_MANAGER alone (PCR-08-005). Returns 422 and queues nothing when the case has no CASE_MANAGER.
post.summary: Add a report to an existing case.

post.description: Creates a local VulnerabilityCase attributed to the actor and queues a CreateCaseActivity in the actor's outbox for delivery to the CaseActor.  An optional report_id links an existing VulnerabilityReport to the new case.
post.summary: Create a new VulnerabilityCase.

post.description: Triggers the defer-case behavior for the given actor. Emits an Ignore(VulnerabilityCase) activity (RmDeferCaseActivity), transitions the actor's RM state to DEFERRED in the case, and returns the activity in the response body (TRIG-04-001).
post.summary: Trigger case deferral.

post.description: Triggers the engage-case behavior for the given actor. Emits a Join(VulnerabilityCase) activity (RmEngageCaseActivity), transitions the actor's RM state to ACCEPTED in the case, and returns the activity in the response body (TRIG-04-001).
post.summary: Trigger case engagement.

post.description: Triggers the invalidate-report behavior for the given actor. Emits a TentativeReject(Offer(VulnerabilityReport)) activity (RmInvalidateReportActivity) and returns it in the response body (TRIG-04-001). Persists a ParticipantStatus record with RM.INVALID for the actor and report.
post.summary: Trigger report invalidation.

post.description: Sends the case owner's Offer of the invitee, with the offered roles, to the case's CASE_MANAGER, which emits and commits the Invite (ADR-0109).  The case must exist in the actor's DataLayer.
post.summary: Directly invite an actor to a case.

post.description: Triggers the leave-case behavior for the given actor, which any participant of the case may call (TRIG-13-001). Runs the actor's PreCloseAction call-out, then queues a Leave(VulnerabilityCase) activity addressed to the case's CASE_MANAGER alone, and returns it in the response body (TRIG-04-001). The CASE_MANAGER decides what the Leave means: the Case Owner's Leave closes the case, and any other participant departs while the case stays open (CM-23-002, CM-23-003). Returns HTTP 409 and queues nothing when the caller is the Case Owner and its replica records an active embargo: terminate the embargo first (TRIG-13-003). Returns HTTP 422 and queues nothing when the PreCloseAction call-out fails (TRIG-13-002).
post.summary: Leave a case.

post.description: Emits an Offer(VulnerabilityCase) (ownership transfer variant) from the requesting actor to the specified transferee.  The case must exist in the actor's DataLayer.  The transferee must also be known (TRIG-11-001).
post.summary: Offer case ownership to another actor.

post.description: Emits Offer(CaseParticipantRole, target=Actor, context=VulnerabilityCase) from the requesting actor.  This is the canonical role-delegation wire format introduced by ADR-0039, replacing the deprecated offer-case-manager-role endpoint.  The Offer is addressed to the case's CASE_MANAGER, which forwards it to the target.  The ``role`` field is required, and the CASE_MANAGER refuses an Offer of ``CASE_OWNER`` or ``CASE_MANAGER`` (CM-33-003).  See SE-08-003.
post.summary: Offer a CVDRole to an Actor in a case (ADR-0039).

post.description: Triggers the propose-embargo behavior for the given actor. Creates a new EmbargoEvent and emits an EmProposeEmbargoActivity (Invite(EmbargoEvent)) activity. EM state transitions: N → P (new proposal) or A → R (revision). Returns the resulting activity in the response body (TRIG-04-001).
post.summary: Trigger an embargo proposal.

post.description: Triggers the propose-embargo-revision behavior for the given actor. Proposes a revision to the active embargo by emitting an EmProposeEmbargoActivity activity. Only valid when EM state is ACTIVE or REVISE; use propose-embargo for initial proposals. EM state transitions: ACTIVE → REVISE or REVISE → REVISE. Returns the resulting activity in the response body (TRIG-04-001).
post.summary: Trigger an embargo revision proposal.

post.description: Rejects an RmInviteToCaseActivity by emitting an RmRejectInviteToCaseActivity queued in the actor's outbox for delivery to the case owner.
post.summary: Reject a case invitation.

post.description: Emits a Reject(Offer(VulnerabilityCase)) from the declining actor to the case's CASE_MANAGER, which ledgers and broadcasts the decline.  The ownership transfer offer must already exist in the actor's DataLayer (TRIG-11-005, CM-21-010, CM-21-012).
post.summary: Decline a case ownership transfer offer.

post.description: Triggers the reject-embargo behavior for the given actor. A participant rejects the current (or specified) embargo proposal with Reject(Invite(EmbargoEvent)), which records its own refusal and moves no EM state. The case owner's reject is its decision for the case, Reject(EmbargoEvent, target=Case), which rejects the proposal (EM state PROPOSED → NONE or REVISE → ACTIVE, or unchanged while another proposal is open). Returns the resulting activity in the response body (TRIG-04-001).
post.summary: Trigger embargo rejection (reject a proposal).

post.description: Answers the CASE_MANAGER's full-case Invite with Reject, carrying this actor's own ledger position.  Fails with 409 until the actor's ledger copy has reached the Invite's position (SYNC-10-004, CM-11-012).
post.summary: Close the case: Reject(full-case Invite), RC.

post.description: Triggers the reject-report behavior for the given actor. Emits a Reject(Offer(VulnerabilityReport)) activity (RmCloseReportActivity) and returns it in the response body (TRIG-04-001). A non-empty note is required (TRIG-03-004). Persists a ParticipantStatus record with RM.CLOSED for the actor and report. Returns HTTP 409 if the report's RM state has no close edge (e.g. VALID; VP-02-004), or if a case holds the report, whose participants close their part in it with leave-case instead (CM-23-019, TRIG-13-001): nothing is emitted.
post.summary: Trigger hard-close of a report.

post.description: Creates a VulnerabilityReport in the actor's DataLayer and queues an RmSubmitReportActivity (Offer) to the specified recipient. An optional proposed_embargo_end_time states the Reporter's embargo terms for the report; the Offer then carries them as proposedEmbargo (EP-04-004). Returns the serialised offer so the caller can deliver it to the recipient's inbox.
post.summary: Create and offer a vulnerability report.

post.description: Emits a RecommendActorActivity addressed to the case owner (typically the CaseActor).  The CaseActor then autonomously invites the suggested actor via RmInviteToCaseActivity.
post.summary: Suggest another actor for a case.

post.description: Answers the CASE_MANAGER's full-case Invite with TentativeReject, carrying this actor's own ledger position.  Fails with 409 until the actor's ledger copy has reached the Invite's position (SYNC-10-004, CM-11-012).
post.summary: Judge the case invalid: TentativeReject(full-case Invite), RI.

post.description: Triggers the terminate-embargo behavior for the given actor. Announces the end of the active embargo by emitting an AnnounceEmbargoActivity activity. Updates the case EM state to EXITED and clears the active embargo. Returns HTTP 409 if no active embargo exists. Returns the resulting activity in the response body (TRIG-04-001).
post.summary: Trigger embargo termination.

post.description: Triggers the validate-report behavior for the given actor. Invokes the ValidateReportBT tree via the bridge layer and returns the resulting ActivityStreams activity (TRIG-04-001).
post.summary: Trigger report validation.

post.description: Emits an Undo(Offer(VulnerabilityCase)) from the offering Case Owner to the case's CASE_MANAGER, which ledgers and broadcasts the withdrawal if the offer is still open.  The ownership transfer offer must already exist in the actor's DataLayer (TRIG-11-006, CM-21-015).
post.summary: Withdraw an open case ownership transfer offer.

post.description: Triggers the withdraw-embargo behavior for the given actor. A participant whose consent to the active embargo is AGREED leaves it by sending Leave(EmbargoEvent) to the CASE_MANAGER; no Invite is named. The participant's consent to the embargo in force, and to any open revision it agreed to, becomes DECLINED; the embargo stays in force for everyone else and the case's EM state does not move (EP-09-013, MSM-07-010). Returns HTTP 409 when no embargo is in force, when the actor's consent to it is not AGREED, or when the actor is the case owner, which ends an embargo with terminate-embargo instead. Returns HTTP 404 when the actor holds no participant record on the case. Returns the resulting activity in the response body (TRIG-04-001).
post.summary: Trigger withdrawal from the embargo in force.
